settings.summary: Set the defaults that shape how your shop appears in search, social shares, and structured data. Product-level changes stay available in each editor.
settings.general.title: Name your shop consistently
settings.general.description: These defaults appear across titles, social cards, and structured data when a page has no more specific value.
settings.site_name.help: Used by %%sitename%%. Defaults to the domain.
settings.tagline.help: Used by %%tagline%% — mostly on the home page.
settings.separator.help: The character between the parts of a title.
settings.organization_name.help: For structured data. Defaults to the shop name.
settings.templates.intro: These templates apply to every record. Each product, collection or page can then be customised individually from its own screen.
settings.templates.title: Start with sensible titles and descriptions
settings.variables.note: An empty variable takes its preceding separator with it — no orphan “·”.
settings.var.title: The product, collection or page name
settings.noindex_filtered_listings.help: Every filter combination is a near-duplicate of the collection. Recommended.
settings.noindex_account: Don't index account, tracking and thank-you pages
settings.indexing.title: Keep low-value pages out of search
settings.indexing.description: These pages remain usable for visitors. The controls only tell search engines which URLs should not become search results.
settings.schema.title: Structured data
settings.schema.description: Help search engines understand your shop, products, ratings, and breadcrumb trail.
settings.twitter_site.help: Without the @ — it will be added.
settings.social_image_id.help: Used when a record has no image of its own.
settings.social.title: Control shared links
settings.social.description: Use a default image and account identity when a product or page does not provide its own social content. Media IDs come from the media library.
settings.sitemap.title: Give crawlers a clean map of your shop
settings.sitemap.description: The sitemap updates after catalogue changes and omits pages marked noindex.
settings.robots_extra.help: Appended after the default rules. One directive per line.
